annotation_provenance.license_metadata: CC-BY-4.0 dataset; does not grant underlying music rights
annotation_provenance.method: Three experts rotate initial annotation, verification and final judgment; Rekordbox automatic beat/downbeat grid inspected and locally corrected; difficult automatic-grid failures excluded. One consensus annotation, not three independent references.
annotation_provenance.csv_schema_from_project: time in seconds; beat position in bar, 1=downbeat. No CSV contents opened locally.
annotation_provenance.identity: Track id is YouTube video id; structure key adds numeric index; local 1423 IDs/keys unique and bijective with CSV filenames. Canonical song grouping across uploads/remixes unverified.
annotation_provenance.timing: No quantitative annotation timestamp uncertainty, exact source PCM hash or decoder/offset contract found. Project warns MP3 offsets vary by decoder. 70 ms is evaluation matching tolerance, not label precision.
annotation_provenance.selection: Frequently played EDM tracks; original/long versions preferred; short/radio edits, mix clips, fading starts and ambiguous structures excluded. Not random representative music sample.
annotation_provenance.local_published_count_discrepancy: Local tracks.jsonl has 61886 unique IDs, versus 56873 unique tracks in article. Same 1423 expert count does not by itself bind extracted tree to published/released bytes.

tracker_comparison.comparator: lightsem.audio.rhythm_clock.clock_from_audio (global broadband/kick tactus plus local adaptive tracking, fixed +17 ms synthetic-onset correction); NOT the older standalone constant-grid GuitarSet baseline
tracker_comparison.overlap: small0 trained on all disclosed data except GTZAN, including GuitarSet comping/Harmonix. Raveform is not a named training corpus; song/recording-level overlap remains unknown. No Raveform crosswalk in inspected local exposure ledgers.
tracker_comparison.existing_runner_limit: run_light_layers_rhythm.py requires CUDA and extracts feature arrays, not independent beat accuracy. Do not run it in this metadata/CPU-only audit. A dedicated prospective comparison adapter is still needed.
